column1: # Lineage policy for the acetate route. Read by bin/panel_scored.py (role=acetoclastic)
# and by report renderers (both roles). Detection policy lives here, not in code.
# role=acetoclastic: a genome with the acetate-route genes is confirmed only when its
#   genus is listed here. Genus level on purpose: Methanosarcinaceae is mostly
#   methylotrophs that do not use acetate (Methanolobus, Methanococcoides,
#   Methanohalophilus, Methanomethylovorans, Methanimicrococcus), and an unnamed genus
#   (GTDB placeholder) is left for review, not confirmed. GTDB suffixes are ignored
# role=anabolic_acetate_genes: methanogen orders whose members carry ACDS/CODH, acs,
#   ackA/pta to build biomass from acetate or CO2, not to make methane from acetate.
#   A genome in these orders with the genes is expected, not a candidate.
#   Names checked against GTDB r232 (gtdb_taxonomy.tsv) and the r226 sample: exact, no suffixes.
